intro: Temples, night markets and mountain air. That is Chiang Mai in one line — but there is a lot more to it. This guide covers when to go, where to stay and what not to miss.

sections.heading: Why visit Chiang Mai
paragraphs: Chiang Mai (Southeast Asia) is known for its culture, food and nature experiences. Overall it is budget-friendly — hostels, homestays and local food keep costs low.

sections.heading: Best time to go
paragraphs: The best time to visit is November to February.

sections.heading: How to get there
paragraphs: Fly from Bangkok (about an hour) or take the overnight train.

sections.heading: Insider tip
paragraphs: Choose elephant sanctuaries that don't offer riding.

faq.q: When is the best time to visit Chiang Mai?
How do I reach Chiang Mai?
faq.a: Fly from Bangkok (about an hour) or take the overnight train.

faq.q: Where should I stay in Chiang Mai?
faq.a: Popular choices: Old City for temples; Nimman for cafés.
